side.why: Your railway can build a Cannery now: it turns fish into canned fish.
side.title: Build a 🥫 Cannery
side.how: 🏗 Build → Cannery: beside your track, near where its fish comes from
side.mira: “Your railway can build a Cannery now: it turns fish into canned fish. A Cannery would change everything,” Mira says.

side.title: Help Gullhaven become a City
side.how: It still needs 🧱 bricks. Tap it to see where each comes from, then tap ⬆ Grow.
side.mira: “Gullhaven needs bricks,” Mira says. “Help it grow into a city.”

ms.actLine: “Look at it,” Mira says from the clock tower. “Every whistle out there is ours.”

main.title: Reach Kelpmoor
main.how: Build a ⚓ Dock on its shore within sea reach of your dock: ships carry goods across.
main.mira: “Sailors talk about Kelpmoor,” Mira says. “They say it’s a coal island, with iron and oil in its hills.”
